description: The DESIGN.md of a page or AI dashboard: colour tokens, type, spacing, components and the rules that keep new sections on brand, every value read from the built files. A section returns the DESIGN.md of the page it was cut from. Components carry their design in the prompt instead.

type.description: page, block (a page section), motion (an animated AI component or an AI platform screen) or chat (an AI dashboard)
